contract.parse_reference_content: Match the upstream FactChecker._parse_response for valid text: plain JSON, fenced JSON, and source-line fallback.
contract.normalize_response: Adapt You.com output.content plus output.sources into overall_rating, summary, claims and citations. Require known ratings, nonempty claims, valid HTTP(S) URLs without credentials, and every cited claim URL to belong to the provider's source list. Resolve exact [n] or [[n]] source references with one-based indices. Non-UNVERIFIABLE claims need at least one source. Reject malformed or unsupported responses with ValueError; never silently turn them into a successful report.

scope: Port the cited fact-checking output contract to You.com Research. Citation consistency is checked; the test suite does not establish factual correctness or provider ranking.
